recipes.name: Kanda poha
steps: Rinse poha and let it soften.
Temper mustard, peanuts, curry leaves and chilli, add onion and potato and cook.
Add turmeric, poha, salt and sugar, toss and finish with lemon and coriander.

recipes.name: Sabudana khichdi
steps: Soak sabudana for 6 hours and drain well.
Mix with crushed roasted peanuts, rock salt and sugar.
Temper cumin and chilli in ghee, cook potato, then toss in the sabudana until translucent.

recipes.name: Sabudana vada
steps: Soak sabudana and mash with boiled potato and crushed peanuts.
Season with chilli, cumin and rock salt and shape patties.
Deep-fry until golden.

recipes.name: Misal pav
steps: Sprout matki and pressure-cook briefly.
Make a spicy rassa from onion, coconut, ginger, garlic, tomato and chilli.
Simmer the sprouts in the rassa.
Serve topped with sev and onion, with pav and lemon.

recipes.name: Pav bhaji
steps: Boil potato, cauliflower and peas.
Cook onion, garlic, capsicum and tomato in butter with pav bhaji masala.
Add the vegetables and mash into a thick bhaji.
Toast pav in butter and serve with onion and lemon.

recipes.name: Vada pav
steps: Mash boiled potato with garlic, chilli and a mustard-curry leaf tempering.
Shape balls, dip in besan batter and deep-fry.
Serve in pav with dry garlic chutney.

recipes.name: Thalipeeth
steps: Mix the multigrain flours with onion, coriander and spices into a soft dough.
Pat thin on a greased tawa and make holes in it.
Cook covered with oil until crisp.

recipes.name: Jowar bhakri
steps: Knead jowar flour with hot water a portion at a time.
Pat into a thin round.
Cook on a tawa, brushing the top with water, and finish over the flame.

recipes.name: Pithla
steps: Whisk besan with water.
Temper mustard, cumin, garlic, chilli and onion.
Pour in the besan and stir until it thickens.

recipes.name: Varan bhaat
steps: Cook toor dal with turmeric and hing and whisk smooth.
Season with salt and a little jaggery.
Serve over steamed rice with ghee.

recipes.name: Amti
steps: Cook toor dal soft.
Add tamarind, jaggery, goda masala and coconut.
Temper mustard and curry leaves and simmer.

recipes.name: Bharli vangi
steps: Grind roasted peanuts, coconut and onion with spices, tamarind and jaggery.
Stuff slit baby brinjals with the masala.
Cook covered in oil with a splash of water until tender.

recipes.name: Kolhapuri chicken
steps: Roast onion, coconut and sesame and grind with the Kolhapuri spices.
Sear chicken with ginger and garlic.
Add the masala, tomato and water and simmer until cooked.

recipes.name: Bombay duck fry
steps: Marinate fish in chilli, turmeric, ginger, garlic and lemon.
Coat in semolina and rice flour.
Shallow-fry until crisp.

recipes.name: Malvani fish curry
steps: Grind coconut with roasted onion, garlic and Malvani masala.
Cook the paste in coconut oil with tamarind and water.
Simmer the fish until just cooked.

recipes.name: Puran poli
steps: Cook chana dal soft, drain and cook with jaggery into a thick puran.
Stuff into a soft flour dough and roll thin.
Cook on a tawa with ghee.

recipes.name: Shrikhand
steps: Hang curd for 6 hours.
Whisk with powdered sugar and cardamom until smooth.
Chill and garnish with nuts.

recipes.name: Ukadiche modak
steps: Cook grated coconut with jaggery and cardamom into a filling.
Make a soft dough from rice flour cooked in hot water with ghee.
Shape pleated cups, fill, seal and steam 12 minutes.

recipes.name: Khaman dhokla
steps: Whisk besan with water, sugar, lemon, turmeric and salt and add fruit salt.
Steam in a greased tin for 15 minutes.
Pour over a tempering of mustard, chilli, curry leaves and sweetened water.

recipes.name: Handvo
steps: Soak, grind and ferment the rice and dals with curd.
Mix in grated lauki, ginger and chilli.
Bake or pan-cook covered over a mustard-sesame tempering until crusty.

recipes.name: Methi thepla
steps: Knead flours with methi, curd, sesame and spices.
Roll thin.
Cook on a tawa with a little oil.

recipes.name: Undhiyu
steps: Make methi muthia from besan and methi and fry.
Grind coconut, peanuts, ginger, chilli and coriander into a masala.
Layer the vegetables with the masala and slow-cook with the muthia.

recipes.name: Gujarati dal
steps: Cook toor dal and whisk smooth with water.
Add tomato, jaggery, peanuts, ginger and chilli and simmer.
Temper mustard, cumin and curry leaves in ghee and add lemon.

recipes.name: Gujarati kadhi
steps: Whisk curd with besan, sugar and water.
Simmer, stirring, until slightly thick.
Temper cumin, mustard, curry leaves, ginger and chilli in ghee.

recipes.name: Sev tameta nu shaak
steps: Temper mustard and cumin.
Cook tomatoes with spices and jaggery into a thick gravy.
Top with sev just before serving.

recipes.name: Khandvi
steps: Cook besan with buttermilk, turmeric and salt, stirring constantly until thick.
Spread thin, cool and roll up.
Top with a mustard-sesame tempering and coconut.

recipes.name: Dal dhokli
steps: Cook a thin sweet-sour Gujarati dal with peanuts.
Roll spiced atta dough thin and cut into diamonds.
Simmer the dhokli in the dal until cooked and finish with ghee.

recipes.name: Lauki muthia
steps: Mix grated lauki with flours, curd and spices into logs.
Steam 20 minutes and slice.
Temper with mustard and sesame and toss.

recipes.name: Goan fish curry
steps: Grind coconut with chillies, coriander, garlic and turmeric.
Cook onion and tomato, add the paste, tamarind and water.
Add fish and simmer until cooked.

recipes.name: Goan prawn curry
steps: Cook onion, garlic and tomato in coconut oil with spices.
Add coconut milk and tamarind and simmer.
Add prawns and cook 4 minutes.

recipes.name: Chicken xacuti
steps: Roast coconut and the whole spices until dark and grind.
Brown onion and sear chicken with ginger and garlic.
Add the xacuti masala and water and simmer.

recipes.name: Pork vindaloo
steps: Grind chillies, garlic, ginger and spices with tamarind into a paste and marinate the pork for 4 hours.
Cook onion in oil, add the pork and marinade.
Simmer covered until tender.

recipes.name: Sindhi kadhi
steps: Roast besan in oil until golden.
Add tomato purée, water and spices and simmer.
Add the vegetables and tamarind and cook until tender.

recipes.name: Sai bhaji
steps: Pressure-cook soaked chana dal with greens, lauki and tomato.
Mash lightly.
Temper with garlic, onion and chilli.

recipes.name: Dal pakwan
steps: Cook chana dal with turmeric until soft but whole.
Roll stiff maida dough with ajwain and deep-fry into crisp pakwan.
Serve dal topped with onion and tamarind chutney with pakwan.

recipes.name: Sol kadhi
steps: Soak kokum (tamarind stands in where unavailable) and extract the juice.
Mix with coconut milk, crushed garlic, chilli and salt.
Serve chilled.

recipes.name: Gatta pulao
steps: Make besan gatte, boil and slice.
Fry onion and whole spices in ghee, add the gatte.
Add soaked rice and water and cook until done.

recipes.name: Laal maas
steps: Marinate mutton in curd and chilli.
Brown onion and garlic in ghee.
Add the mutton and slow-cook until tender and the gravy is red and thick.

recipes.name: Pyaaz kachori
steps: Cook onion with besan and spices into a dry filling.
Stuff into rounds of maida dough and flatten.
Deep-fry slowly until crisp.

recipes.name: Bajra khichdi
steps: Soak pounded bajra overnight.
Pressure-cook with moong dal and turmeric.
Finish with a ghee, cumin and hing tempering.

recipes.name: Kothimbir vadi
steps: Mix coriander, besan and spices into a thick batter.
Steam in a tray for 15 minutes and cut into squares.
Shallow-fry until crisp.

recipes.name: Aamras
steps: Pulp ripe mangoes.
Blend with a little sugar, milk and cardamom.
Chill before serving.

recipes.name: Chicken sukka
steps: Roast coconut until brown.
Cook chicken with onion, spices and tamarind in ghee.
Add the coconut and dry-roast until coated.

recipes.name: Fafda
steps: Knead besan with ajwain, pepper, salt and a little oil.
Press strips on a board with the palm.
Deep-fry until crisp.

recipes.name: Dabeli
steps: Mash potato with dabeli masala, tamarind and jaggery.
Fill buttered pav with the mash, roasted peanuts, pomegranate and onion.
Toast and roll the edges in sev.

recipes.name: Malvani vade
steps: Mix rice flour with roasted ground urad, fennel and fenugreek and knead with hot water.
Pat into small rounds.
Deep-fry until puffed.

recipes.name: Batata bhaji
steps: Boil and cube potatoes.
Temper mustard, cumin, curry leaves and chilli with turmeric.
Toss the potatoes and finish with lemon and coriander.

recipes.name: Matki usal
steps: Sprout the matki.
Temper mustard, cook onion, garlic, tomato and spices.
Add sprouts, coconut, jaggery and a little water and cook until tender.
